scope: Profile the public host and remove measured clip-time CPU material recompilation. Not general GPU optimization, stable 60 FPS, exact display registration, default migration or photographic approval.

implementation.cache: Default presentation prototypes for root and all compiled dependencies, scoped per root/Arc<CompiledEffectProject>. Rebuilt on project artifact replacement, retired when root/project playback is removed.
implementation.sharing: Immutable compiled material programs only; new EffectInstance, automatic runtime bindings and output identity; default clocks/seed/parameters/history; explicit bindings/resource overrides reset. Normal clip configuration applies authored parameters, seeds and policy.
implementation.tradeoffs: Compilation moves to initial project preparation. Independent roots currently have separate prototype sets; not a global program cache or GPU buffer pooling.

profiling.transport: Existing asynchronous GPU timestamps, latest-frame CPU encoding ledger and per-owner CPU scopes; no new particle readback or GPU waits.
profiling.limitations: Scheduled CPU wall windows can include interleaving. Initial activation timer excludes render-thread GPU allocation/submission. GPU measurements are asynchronous; per-owner complete-window metadata can omit retired/query-budget-omitted owners. Nested/repeated paths are not independent totals; use outer simulation scope for aggregate comparisons.

encoding_ledger.scope: CPU command encoding only; asynchronous latest frame, no GPU completion fence or visible-pixel assertion. Stateful quantization up to one simulation tick is expected.

preliminary.scope: Discovery runs retained. Before direct clip-construction timer; binary/source inventory not independently snapshotted, so these are supporting diagnosis rather than primary before/after provenance.

observations.cached_runs: All four complete with zero late pipelines, exact clip scheduling, no blocked or missing scheduled owners, 13 accepted flashes, zero final async observed populations.
observations.cached_plain_wispy: Two repetitions: p95 31.214/31.680 ms; max sampled encoding lag 100.001/33.334 ms. This variance prevents a universal latency claim.
observations.cached_plain_persistent: p95 27.194 ms; max sampled encoding lag 16.668 ms. Not stable-60-FPS acceptance.

next: Measure render-thread allocation and coupled simulation upload/dispatch costs, including event-list and parameter buffer churn. Optimize the measured work before revisiting live catch-up policy, preserving cue delivery and PlaybackOnly.
